ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are two slanted blue lines labeled a and b, and identical pink arrow marks are used to indicate that they are parallel; the upper horizontal blue line is labeled c, crossing through these two slanted lines. ∠3 is located at the intersection of b and c, between the two slanted parallel lines and above c; ∠7 is located at the intersection of a and c, also between the two slanted parallel lines but below c. The problem gives m∠3 = 43. Reasoning: Regard c as a transversal; it intersects the parallel lines a and b. ∠3 and ∠7 are located between the two parallel lines, and on opposite sides of the transversal c, so they are alternate interior angles. When parallel lines are intersected by a transversal, alternate interior angles are equal, therefore m∠7 = m∠3 = 43.

raw_record.question_text: In the figure, $m\angle 3 = 43$. Find the measure of $\angle 7$.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as showing the two slanted lines labeled a and b marked parallel, with the top horizontal line c acting as a transversal. Locate angle 3 at the intersection of b and c, and angle 7 at the intersection of a and c. These two angles lie between the parallel slanted lines and on opposite sides of transversal c, so they are alternate interior angles. Therefore m∠7 = m∠3 = 43.
